Slide through every sound: kuh, aah, tuh, cat.
In short words, a says aah, like in apple, and i says ih, like in itch.
Pig has three sounds: puh, ih, guh.
Short o says aw, like octopus.
Say every sound at the end: huh, aah, [nnn](/nnn/), duh.
It says [sss](/sss/), like the start of snake.
Teeth together, smile, and let the air hiss out like a snake: [sss](/sss/).
C usually says kuh, like in cat.
g often says juh: gem, giraffe.
